title: Departed-Balance Covers: Lunch Charge by the Receiving Student's Enrolled Campus (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
The lunch charge a departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts follows the campus on the student's enrollment record in status enrolled, as held in the district's Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions records: the CEP meal charge at Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary or Hollis Middle School; the secondary lunch charge of the student's meal status at Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School or Mesquite Ridge High School; the elementary lunch charge of the student's meal status at any other campus or when the student holds no enrollment record in status enrolled.

| Campus on the enrollment record in status enrolled | Lunch charge a departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts |
|---|---|
| Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary, Hollis Middle School | the CEP meal charge (0.00) |
| Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School, Mesquite Ridge High School | the secondary lunch charge of the meal status |
| any other campus | the elementary lunch charge of the meal status |
| no enrollment record in status enrolled | the elementary lunch charge of the meal status |

The record read is the student's enrollment record in status enrolled; a record in any other status does not set the campus.

## Basis questions (hypothetical students)

**What lunch charge is counted for a student on Paid Meal Status, enrolled at Calloway Creek High School?** 3.45.

**What lunch charge is counted for a student on Reduced-Price Meal Status, enrolled at Sunflower Early Childhood Center?** 0.40.

**What lunch charge is counted for a student on Paid Meal Status, enrolled at Pecan Grove Elementary?** 0.00.

**What lunch charge is counted for a student on Paid Meal Status whose only enrollment record is in status withdrawn?** 3.10.
